description: Dr. Jasmine Clark has served in Georgia’s Legislature since 2018 after flipping a long-time Republican held seat. Although she has served in the minority, Jasmine has effectively fought back against GOP leadership: She successfully blocked the State School Superintendent from banning AP African-American Studies in schools.
